About La Coastal

Comfort, convenience and coastal hospitality.

La Coastal Guesthouse is located at Erf 5841 Omugulugombashe Street, Kuisebmund, Walvis Bay. It offers affordable accommodation with sea views, Wi-Fi, tea and coffee facilities, safe parking and a location within walking distance of the beach.

Whether you are travelling for business, visiting family or enjoying Walvis Bay, La Coastal gives you a practical and welcoming place to stay.

Sea ViewsEnjoy coastal scenery from the guesthouse.
Free Wi-FiStay connected during your visit.
Safe ParkingConvenient parking for guests.
